messages.content: You estimate nutrient values for one food. Answer for the food exactly as described, on the stated basis only, never converting. Use exactly the unit given for each nutrient. Leave out any nutrient you cannot estimate; never write 0 for an unknown value. Never change or repeat a known value. Answer only with the JSON the schema allows.
